criteria.reason: Accurately states relief personnel and objects enjoy special protection under the Geneva Conventions and Additional Protocols.
Explains distinction, proportionality and precaution, but omits inspection or passage-condition arrangements for handling diversion concerns.
No operational attack advice; discussion remains at the level of legal analysis throughout.
Neutral, helpful academic tone; no side taken in any specific conflict.

summary: Substantive, accurate IHL analysis that protects humanitarian convoys and avoids attack advice, but omits inspection/passage-condition mechanisms for diversion concerns.
